commits.message:
fix(demos): live-terminal rows at the page's line height; claude-sessions footer fits 80 columns (rich-demos-z4hd) (#306)

* fix(demos): live-terminal rows sit at the page's line height; the claude-sessions footer fits 80 columns (rich-demos-z4hd)

xterm makes a row its measured character height times its lineHeight option,
rounded to device pixels, so the factor live-terminal.ts handed it never landed
on the page's line height: rows were 20px against a 17.5px line, and the landing
showcase grew 483px -> 543px on its first frame. xterm now measures its
character at the page's line height (custom.css) with the option left at 1,
and that line height is rounded to a whole pixel so static output and live
rows share it.

The claude-sessions footer is one Layout row and wrapped when narrower than
its hints, cutting "q quit" at 80 columns with no sign. It now draws the
leading hints that fit and counts the rest ("+8 more"); the lists lead with
moving, focus and quit.

* fix(demos): live rows land on the page's line height at any device pixel ratio; the status bar measures itself and never wraps (rich-demos-z4hd)

xterm measures a character in whole CSS pixels (offsetHeight) and makes a row
that rounded up to whole device pixels, so a whole-pixel line height only
matches at dpr 1. custom.css now measures xterm at --rich-fragment-line and
derives the page's line height from it the way xterm does, with the ratio
tracked on :root; the measure rule moves into loadXterm so every LiveTerminal
has it. The status bar reads its width off its own markup and is drawn
no-wrap with an ellipsis, so it is one row at every width.

* fix(docs): a browser without CSS round() keeps the fragment font, at the 1.25 line height (rich-demos-z4hd)

The line height is one custom property shared by every place output is
drawn, and the only one that needs round(); @supports not swaps it for 1.25,
so the font shorthand never goes invalid where it is used.
